---
title: "Letterboxd Recs"
description: "Personalized, weekly fresh film recommendations built from taste similarity and streaming availability."
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

<style>
  body:has(#letterboxd-recs) #quarto-content { max-width: 1160px; }
  body:has(#letterboxd-recs) main.content { max-width: none; width: 100%; }
  .recs-note { color: #aaa; font-size: .85rem; margin: 1.5rem 0 .75rem; }
  .recs-grid { overflow-x: auto; border-top: 1px solid #333; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .recs-row, .recs-controls {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 62px 90px 70px minmax(180px, 1.6fr) 86px minmax(150px, 1.4fr) 90px;
    gap: 12px;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px 4px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
    font-size: .9rem;
    min-width: 860px;
  }
  .recs-controls { color: #aaa; font-size: .75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; }
  .recs-head-cell { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: .35rem; }
  .recs-controls button { appearance: none; background: none; border: 0; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; letter-spacing: inherit; padding: 0; text-align: left; text-transform: inherit; }
  .recs-controls button:hover, .recs-controls button.active { color: #fff; }
  .recs-controls select, .recs-controls input { width: 100%; background: #111; border: 1px solid #555; color: #eee; font: inherit; padding: .4rem; }
  .recs-controls .toggle { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; }
  .recs-controls .toggle input { width: auto; }
  .recs-title { color: inherit; font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; }
  .recs-title:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
  .recs-genres, .recs-availability, .recs-empty { color: #aaa; }
  .recs-availability { font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .recs-movement { font-size: .78rem; }
  .recs-movement.up { color: #7bd88f; }
  .recs-movement.down { color: #ff7b72; }
</style>

<div id="letterboxd-recs">
<p class="recs-note" id="recs-updated">Loading the latest recommendations…</p>
<div class="recs-grid">
<div class="recs-controls">
<div class="recs-head-cell"><button class="recs-sort" data-sort="rank" data-direction="asc" type="button">Rank</button></div>
<div class="recs-head-cell"><button class="recs-sort" data-sort="movement" data-direction="desc" type="button">Movement</button></div>
<div class="recs-head-cell"><button class="recs-sort" data-sort="score" data-direction="desc" type="button">Score</button></div>
<div class="recs-head-cell"><button class="recs-sort" data-sort="title" data-direction="asc" type="button">Title</button><select id="recs-provider" aria-label="Provider"><option value="">Provider: all</option></select></div>
<div class="recs-head-cell"><button class="recs-sort" data-sort="year" data-direction="desc" type="button">Year</button><input id="recs-min-year" type="number" placeholder="Min" aria-label="Minimum year"></div>
<div class="recs-head-cell"><button class="recs-sort" data-sort="genre" data-direction="asc" type="button">Genre</button><select id="recs-genre" aria-label="Genre"><option value="">All</option></select></div>
<div class="recs-head-cell"><button class="recs-sort" data-sort="availability" data-direction="desc" type="button">Available</button><label class="toggle"><input id="recs-stream-only" type="checkbox"> Stream only</label></div>
</div>
<div id="recs-rows"></div>
</div>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  const sourceUrl = 'https://spazznolo.github.io/letterboxd-recs/';
  const updated = document.getElementById('recs-updated');
  const providerSelect = document.getElementById('recs-provider');
  const genreSelect = document.getElementById('recs-genre');
  const minYearInput = document.getElementById('recs-min-year');
  const streamOnlyInput = document.getElementById('recs-stream-only');
  const sortButtons = [...document.querySelectorAll('.recs-sort')];
  const rows = document.getElementById('recs-rows');
  let sortKey = 'rank', sortDirection = 'asc', data;

  const escapeHTML = value => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>'"]/g, char => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;',"'":'&#39;','"':'&quot;'}[char]));
  const addOption = (select, value, label) => {
    const option = document.createElement('option');
    option.value = value; option.textContent = label; select.appendChild(option);
  };
  const movement = film => {
    if (film.previous_rank === null || film.previous_rank === undefined) return '<span class="recs-movement">new</span>';
    const change = Number(film.rank_change);
    if (!Number.isFinite(change) || change === 0) return '<span class="recs-movement">—</span>';
    return `<span class="recs-movement ${change > 0 ? 'up' : 'down'}">${change > 0 ? '↑' : '↓'}${Math.abs(change)}</span>`;
  };
  const updateSortButtons = () => {
    sortButtons.forEach(button => {
      const active = button.dataset.sort === sortKey;
      button.textContent = `${button.dataset.sort[0].toUpperCase()}${button.dataset.sort.slice(1)}${active ? ` ${sortDirection === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓'}` : ''}`;
      button.classList.toggle('active', active);
    });
  };
  const sortValue = (film, key) => {
    if (key === 'rank') return Number(film.current_rank);
    if (key === 'movement') return film.previous_rank == null ? null : Number(film.rank_change);
    if (key === 'score') return Number(film.score_scaled ?? film.score);
    if (key === 'title') return String(film.title || '').toLowerCase();
    if (key === 'year') return Number(film.year);
    if (key === 'genre') return (film.genres || []).join(', ').toLowerCase();
    if (key === 'availability') return Number(Boolean(film.stream));
    return Number(film.current_rank);
  };
  const render = () => {
    if (!data) return;
    const provider = providerSelect.value, genre = genreSelect.value;
    const minYear = Number.parseInt(minYearInput.value, 10), streamOnly = streamOnlyInput.checked;
    const filtered = data.films.filter(film => {
      if (provider && !film.providers?.[provider]) return false;
      if (genre && !(film.genres || []).includes(genre)) return false;
      if (Number.isFinite(minYear) && film.year && film.year < minYear) return false;
      return !(streamOnly && !film.stream);
    });
    filtered.sort((left, right) => {
      const leftValue = sortValue(left, sortKey), rightValue = sortValue(right, sortKey);
      if (leftValue == null && rightValue == null) return Number(left.current_rank) - Number(right.current_rank);
      if (leftValue == null) return 1;
      if (rightValue == null) return -1;
      const comparison = typeof leftValue === 'string' ? leftValue.localeCompare(rightValue) : leftValue - rightValue;
      return (sortDirection === 'asc' ? 1 : -1) * comparison || Number(left.current_rank) - Number(right.current_rank);
    });
    updateSortButtons();
    if (!filtered.length) { rows.innerHTML = '<div class="recs-row"><span class="recs-empty">No films match these filters.</span></div>'; return; }
    rows.innerHTML = filtered.map(film => {
      const title = escapeHTML(film.title), url = /^https:\/\//.test(film.letterboxd_url || '') ? escapeHTML(film.letterboxd_url) : '';
      const titleHTML = url ? `<a class="recs-title" href="${url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${title}</a>` : `<span class="recs-title">${title}</span>`;
      const score = Number(film.score_scaled ?? film.score);
      return `<div class="recs-row"><span data-label="Rank">${Number(film.current_rank)}</span><span data-label="Movement">${movement(film)}</span><span data-label="Score">${Number.isFinite(score) ? score.toFixed(2) : '—'}</span><span data-label="Title">${titleHTML}</span><span data-label="Year">${film.year || '—'}</span><span class="recs-genres" data-label="Genres">${escapeHTML((film.genres || []).join(', ') || 'Unknown')}</span><span class="recs-availability" data-label="Available">${film.stream ? 'stream' : 'rent'}</span></div>`;
    }).join('');
  };

  fetch(sourceUrl)
    .then(response => { if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Recommendations: ${response.status}`); return response.text(); })
    .then(html => {
      const source = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html').getElementById('recs-data');
      if (!source) throw new Error('Recommendation data was not found.');
      data = JSON.parse(source.textContent || '{}');
      const date = new Date(data.generated_at);
      updated.textContent = `Last updated: ${date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric'})}`;
      (data.providers || []).forEach(provider => addOption(providerSelect, provider, provider.replaceAll('_', ' ')));
      [...new Set(data.films.flatMap(film => film.genres || []))].sort().forEach(genre => addOption(genreSelect, genre, genre));
      render();
    })
    .catch(error => { updated.textContent = 'The latest recommendations could not be loaded.'; console.error(error); });

  providerSelect.addEventListener('change', render);
  genreSelect.addEventListener('change', render);
  minYearInput.addEventListener('input', render);
  streamOnlyInput.addEventListener('change', render);
  sortButtons.forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const nextSort = button.dataset.sort;
    sortDirection = sortKey === nextSort ? (sortDirection === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc') : button.dataset.direction;
    sortKey = nextSort;
    render();
  }));
})();
</script>
